sentences.text: Berruornis is an early fossil genus of an owl or an owl-like bird.
The animal was approximately the size of a modern Eurasian eagle-owl.
The genus was first described by Mourer-Chauviré in 1994.
The only known species within the genus is Berruornis orbisantiqui.
The fossils were recovered from late Paleocene deposits near Reims in northeastern France.
It belongs to the order Strigiformes, which includes owls.
Fossils of Berruornis date from the Paleocene to the Eocene epochs.
The species lived between 61.66 and 56 million years ago during the Selandian and Thanetian stages.
